gaps: Quantity values cannot be changed through the available operations for this setup.
The read-back fields do not expose bid prices or quantities, so exact value preservation cannot be asserted.

The plan cannot encode the acceptable alternative outcome where each individual value is refused with a readable message; it only sends the values and permits refusal without stopping subsequent attempts.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 0.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 999999999999.99.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 10000000000.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 0.000001.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds.
